tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you for joining the study today. I'd like to ask you some questions about your education experiences. First, which do you think is more important for a college, offering a wide variety of courses or having small class sizes? Why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：感谢您参与今天的访谈。我想问您几个关于教育经历的问题。首先，您认为对于大学来说，提供多样化的课程更重要，还是小班教学更重要？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: I see. Imagine that you are preparing for a test. Would you prefer to study by yourself or with a group? What would make you choose one over the other?
tasks.analysis: 中文：明白了。假设您正在准备一场考试，您更愿意自己学习还是和小组一起学习？是什么因素让您选择其中一种方式而非另一种？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Interesting. Some people believe that online courses offer more flexibility and accessibility compared to those offered in traditional classroom settings and are therefore superior. What are your thoughts on this? Do you agree or disagree? Why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：有意思。有些人认为，与传统的课堂环境相比，在线课程提供了更大的灵活性和可及性，因此更优越。您对此有什么看法？您同意还是不同意？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Good points. Lastly, online courses are becoming increasingly popular and there are now full degree programs offered by universities where every class is available online only. Do you think online learning will someday completely replace in person learning? Explain your thoughts.
tasks.analysis: 中文：说得好。最后，在线课程正变得越来越受欢迎，现在有些大学提供完整的学位课程，所有课程都只能在线上完成。您认为在线学习有一天会完全取代面对面学习吗？请说明您的想法。
tasks.title: Interview
